messages:
kiran: quick q — external contractor needs console access to debug a P0 in prod for ~2 hours. They only need to view app logs in the prod project. Whats the minimal console role we can grant so they can't see PII or other projects?

sarah: short answer: grant only roles/logging.viewer at the project scope and use a short-lived (JIT) binding. avoid broad roles like Project Viewer or Owner. also ensure any logs with PII are redacted or routed to a sanitized sink. :lock:

sam: +1. if you want an explicit conditional expiry we can add an IAM condition so it auto-expires. example we used recently:
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding my-prod-project \
  --member='user:contractor@vendor.com' \
  --role='roles/logging.viewer' \
  --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp("2026-03-17T17:30:00Z"),title="temp-debug",description="2h debug access"'
```
That gives them only log read permission for that project until the timestamp.

linda: couple of extra safety items:
- create a short JIRA approval so we have an auditable ticket (attach expiration and justification).
- set up a temporary log view in the console that filters out sensitive fields OR configure the log router to redact sensitiveFields (email, ssn, payment info) before they appear in the console.
- if the contractor needs trace/monitoring views, add roles/monitoring.viewer separately, not project viewer.

security-bot: reminder — any external account grant must include MFA check and be logged: file a security review form (link: https://internal.redwood/security-access).

kiran: thanks — two clarifying q's: 1) where do we edit redaction rules (console vs log router)? 2) can we scope the binding to a single service (like logs from service-A) instead of whole project?

sarah: redaction: use the log router (logging sinks) to transform/redact before it lands in the project console tables. For console-side filtering you can create a logs view but its not a secure redaction (just UI).

sam: scoping: you can create a logs-based IAM condition to check resource.labels/service == "service-A" in the condition expression, but conditions get tricky. safer/cleaner: create a separate prod-logs dataset or folder for service-A and give role on that resource.

linda: operational checklist for you to follow:
- open JIRA with justification + expiry time
- run the gcloud conditional binding (or use IAM console JIT flow)
- add log router redaction rules for sensitive fields
- security team will review and confirm (Ill do a quick review post-JIRA)

kiran: perfect — Ill open the ticket now and ping @sarah @linda when done. thanks all :thumbsup:
